topics.name: C++ Fundamentals & STL
topics.description: Mastering pointer mechanics, memory allocation, vectors, sets, maps, and Standard Template Library power utilities for optimal coding.

topics.name: Data Structures & Algorithms
topics.description: Comprehensive analysis and building of core structures from scratch to understand algorithmic efficiency and runtime trade-offs.

topics.name: Arrays & Strings
topics.description: Two-pointer techniques, sliding windows, string matching algorithms, and matrix traversals commonly tested in technical interviews.

topics.name: Linked Lists & Pointers
topics.description: Singly, doubly, and circular linked lists, reversing techniques, slow/fast pointer algorithms (Floyd's cycle detection), and memory management.

topics.name: Stacks & Queues
topics.description: Monotonic stacks, queue evaluation, expression evaluation (Infix/Postfix), and real-world system queue simulations.

topics.name: Trees & Binary Search Trees
topics.description: Recursive & iterative tree traversals (Inorder, Preorder, Postorder, Level-order), BST validation, and height balancing.

topics.name: Graph Theory & Algorithms
topics.description: Breadth-First Search (BFS), Depth-First Search (DFS), shortest path algorithms (Dijkstra's), cycle detection, and topological sorting.

topics.name: Recursion, DP & Backtracking
topics.description: Breaking complex problems into overlapping subproblems, memoization, tabular dynamic programming, and systematic state exploration.

topics.name: Time & Space Complexity
topics.description: Rigorous Big-O, Big-Omega, and Big-Theta notation analysis to evaluate algorithm scalability before writing a single line of code.

topics.name: Interview Pattern Recognition
topics.description: Training students to rapidly identify standard coding patterns under pressure rather than memorizing individual answers.

topics.name: Debugging & Clean Code
topics.description: Systematic stepping, variable inspection, memory leak checks, and writing self-documenting code following engineering standards.
